{{Top|leg}}
A '''Nisbat''' was a form of tracking device used by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]]. They were inserted into a target's body, sometimes without the host's prior knowledge. Yuuzhan Vong collaborator [[Viqi Shesh]] was implanted with one [[27 ABY/Legends|around the time of Coruscant's capture]], shortly before her [[Death/Legends|death]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Yuuzhan'tar]].
